SELECT T.djxh, T.ckbgdh, T.nsrsbh, T.nsrmc, T.ckrq, T.ckspdm, T.ckspmc, T.cksl, T.mylj, T.rmbj, T.cytssbjl, T.gzxx, T.czr_dm as czrDm, T.czrq FROM ( -- 报关单数据 SELECT g.djxh, g.ckbgdh, g.gzxx, g.czr_dm, g.czrq, d.nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, bgd.ckrq_1 as ckrq, bgd.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(bgd.hgspmc, bgd.ckspmc) as ckspmc, bgd.cksl, bgd.mylaj as mylj, bgd.rmblaj as rmbj, bgd.cytssbjl FROM ZJ_BJTS.yj_bgdgzxx_gcb g INNER JOIN hx_ckts.ckts_ba_baxx_jgb a ON g.djxh = a.djxh INNER JOIN hx_dj.dj_nsrxx d ON g.djxh = d.djxh INNER JOIN hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 bgd ON g.djxh=bgd.djxh and g.ckbgdh = bgd.ckbgdh WHERE a.tsswjg_dm_1 like #{swjgdm}||'%'
AND g.ckbgdh = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND d.nsrsbh LIKE '%' || #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND d.nsrmc LIKE '%' || #{nsrmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND g.czrq >= TO_DATE(#{czrqStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND g.czrq <= TO_DATE(#{czrqEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
UNION -- 代理出口货物证明数据 SELECT g.djxh, g.ckbgdh, g.gzxx, g.czr_dm, g.czrq, d.nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, dlc.ckrq_1 as ckrq, dlc.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(dlc.hgspmc, dlc.ckspmc) as ckspmc, dlc.cksl, dlc.mylaj as mylj, dlc.rmblaj as rmbj, dlc.cytssbjl as cytssb FROM ZJ_BJTS.yj_bgdgzxx_gcb g INNER JOIN hx_ckts.ckts_ba_baxx_jgb a ON g.djxh = a.djxh INNER JOIN hx_dj.dj_nsrxx d ON g.djxh = d.djxh INNER JOIN hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_zj_dlckhwzm dlc ON g.djxh=dlc.djxh and a.tsswjg_dm_1=dlc.tsswjg_dm_1 and g.ckbgdh = dlc.dlckhwzmhm WHERE a.tsswjg_dm_1 like #{swjgdm}||'%'
AND g.ckbgdh = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND d.nsrsbh LIKE '%' || #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND d.nsrmc LIKE '%' || #{nsrmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND g.czrq >= TO_DATE(#{czrqStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND g.czrq <= TO_DATE(#{czrqEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
) T
ORDER BY T.${orderSql}
ORDER BY T.czrq DESC

SELECT T.djxh, T.ckbgdh, T.nsrsbh, T.nsrmc, T.ckrq, T.ckspdm, T.ckspmc, T.cksl, T.mylj, T.rmbj, T.cytssbjl, T.gzxx, T.czr_dm as czrDm, T.czrq FROM ( SELECT j.djxh, j.ckbgdh, j.gzxx, j.czr_dm, j.czrq, d.nsrdjno as nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, bgd.ckrq_1 as ckrq, bgd.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(bgd.hgspmc, bgd.ckspmc) as ckspmc, bgd.cksl, bgd.mylaj as mylj, bgd.rmblaj as rmbj, bgd.cytssbjl FROM TL_TSSH.yj_bgdgzxx_jgb j INNER JOIN glxt_bb_shxt_djxx d ON j.djxh = d.djxh_js INNER JOIN TL_TSSH.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd bgd ON j.ckbgdh = bgd.ckbgdh and j.djxh=bgd.djxh WHERE d.swjgdm like #{swjgdm}||'%'
AND j.ckbgdh = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND d.nsrdjno LIKE '%' || #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND d.nsrmc LIKE '%' || #{nsrmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND j.czrq >= TO_DATE(#{czrqStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND j.czrq <= TO_DATE(#{czrqEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
UNION SELECT j.djxh, j.ckbgdh, j.gzxx, j.czr_dm, j.czrq, d.nsrdjno as nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, dlc.ckrq_1 as ckrq, dlc.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(dlc.hgspmc, dlc.ckspmc) as ckspmc, dlc.cksl, dlc.mylaj as mylj, dlc.rmblaj as rmbj, dlc.cytssbjl FROM TL_TSSH.yj_bgdgzxx_jgb j INNER JOIN glxt_bb_shxt_djxx d ON j.djxh = d.djxh_js INNER JOIN tl_tssh.ckts_wbsj_zj_dlckhwzm dlc ON j.djxh=dlc.djxh and j.ckbgdh = dlc.dlckhwzmhm WHERE d.swjgdm like #{swjgdm}||'%'
AND j.ckbgdh = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND d.nsrdjno LIKE '%' || #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND d.nsrmc LIKE '%' || #{nsrmc,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND j.czrq >= TO_DATE(#{czrqStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND j.czrq <= TO_DATE(#{czrqEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
) T
ORDER BY T.${orderSql}
ORDER BY T.czrq DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT bgd.djxh as djxh, bgd.ckbgdh, d.nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, bgd.ckrq_1 as ckrq, bgd.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(bgd.hgspmc, bgd.ckspmc) as ckspmc, bgd.cksl, bgd.mylaj as mylj, bgd.rmblaj as rmbj, bgd.cytssbjl FROM hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_hg_bgd201 bgd INNER JOIN HX_DJ.DJ_NSRXX d ON bgd.djxh = d.djxh WHERE d.nsrsbh = #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND bgd.ckbgdh = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d.zgswj_dm like #{qxdm}||'%' UNION ALL SELECT dlc.djxh as djxh, dlc.dlckhwzmhm as ckbgdh, d.nsrsbh, d.nsrmc, dlc.ckrq_1 as ckrq, dlc.cksp_dm as ckspdm, nvl(dlc.hgspmc, dlc.ckspmc) as ckspmc, dlc.cksl, dlc.mylaj as mylj, dlc.rmblaj as rmbj, dlc.cytssbjl FROM hx_ckts.ckts_wbsj_zj_dlckhwzm dlc INNER JOIN HX_DJ.DJ_NSRXX d ON dlc.djxh = d.djxh WHERE d.nsrsbh = #{nsrsbh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dlc.dlckhwzmhm = #{ckbgdh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and d.zgswj_dm like #{qxdm}||'%' ) WHERE rownum = 1

SELECT g.djxh, g.ckbgdh, g.gzxx, g.czr_dm as czrDm, g.czrq FROM ZJ_BJTS.yj_bgdgzxx_gcb g WHERE exists ( select 1 from hx_ckts.ckts_sb_mdt_tssb_jgb a where a.djxh=g.djxh and nvl(a.ckbgdh,a.dlckhwzmhm)=g.ckbgdh union all select 1 from hx_ckts.ckts_sb_mts_tssb_jgb b where b.djxh=g.djxh and nvl(b.ckbgdh,b.dlzmh)=g.ckbgdh )
